title: HTML is a native image format, hear me out
summary: An article exploring the unconventional concept of treating HTML as a native image format, discussing how HTML/CSS can represent visual content in ways that traditional raster or vector formats cannot, potentially revolutionizing how we think about web-based visual assets.
problem_solved: Reimagines how visual content can be represented, accessed, and manipulated on the web by treating HTML as a native image format.
why_valuable: This approach could enable more accessible, searchable, and dynamically modifiable visual content that bridges the gap between documents and images.
